# Issue: Fix Stale References in Root AGENTS.md, copilot-instructions.md & CI Path Filters

> **DRY-RUN NOTICE**: This is an issue-only artifact. No GitHub API call was made.

## Description

**Problem**:
The workspace specification (root `AGENTS.md`, §13) documents 6 known stale references that reduce agent reliability and CI accuracy. These include incorrect toolkit paths, missing files referenced by documentation, and stale inventory counts.

**Proposed Solution**  
Resolve all stale references documented in `AGENTS.md` §13:

| # | Issue | Affected File | Fix |
|---|-------|--------------|-----|
| 1 | `Bash/` → `projects/Bash/` | `copilot-instructions.md` (13 references) | Update all `Bash/` → `projects/Bash/` |
| 2 | CI path filter wrong | `bash-scripts-ci.yml` | `Bash/**` → `projects/Bash/**` |
| 3 | Missing `SOUL.md` reference | Root `AGENTS.md` | Remove or redirect reference |
| 4 | Missing `PROJECT_RULES.md` reference | Root `README.md` | Remove or create file reference |
| 5 | Wrong package-manager hint | `.github/instructions/*` | `pnpm` → `bun` in prompt boilerplate |
| 6 | Stale inventory numbers | `copilot-instructions.md` | Refresh to current counts (174 agents, 186 instructions) |

**Context**  
These references were discovered during a workspace audit on 2026-07-09 and are verified against actual filesystem layout. The broken CI path filter means the `bash-scripts-ci.yml` workflow may fail to trigger on toolkit changes. The stale doc references cause agents to look for files that don't exist.
